reset: completed resets consecutive failures; neutral outcomes do not clear them
selection: nominate the positive step with minimum summed training loss; ties choose smallest; baseline is the control, not a selectable challenger
limits: Fresh deterministic synthetic trajectories; public and not blinded, not real-traffic evidence.
No scenario from the previous study is relabeled as new evaluation.
Only a local proposed finish adapter changes cooldown; the live controller remains unchanged.
The adapter receives only committed failure history and the current observed outcome, never future windows.
A positive-step challenger is evaluated even when training does not beat the control; that failure disqualifies promotion.
The loss weights and all nonregression gates match the preceding study and are not retuned after observing results.
The simulator excludes authentication, registration, daily quotas, backups, CPU and network; it simulates mission processes.
Synthetic loss is not money, energy, wellbeing or probability of sustained life.
Eligibility permits review only. No production learning, automatic deploy or permissions change.
